text: Celtics face 76ers as Tatum and Brown meet for first time since trade. The Boston Celtics play the Philadelphia 76ers on Tuesday, November 10, in Philadelphia, the first game between Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown since Brown was traded to the 76ers in July. The matchup has drawn attention because of the unresolved tension between the two former Celtics teammates.. Tatum and Brown spent nine seasons together in Boston and won an NBA championship in 2024. The relationship had worn down for years as the Celtics treated Tatum as their central player, and Brown was traded in early July in a deal that sent Paul George and draft picks to Boston. Brown has said he does not expect to talk with Tatum before the game, and Tatum has played down a personal rivalry, saying the focus is on the two teams..
